text: {"name":"mac_reset_sequence","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Performs the RWNXL MAC/controller reset sequence, reinitializes controller state, handles an optional periodic update timer, and restores the nested interrupt state.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v2":"reset_nesting_count","v4":"delay_start_tick","v5":"delay_deadline_tick","v6":"ticks_until_deadline","v8":"periodic_update_config","v11":"timestamp_snapshot","v13":"reset_nesting_count_value","v14":"decremented_nesting_count","v15":"restore_interrupts","v18":"update_interval_units","v19":"current_tick"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"periodic update configuration enabled"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"terminal value used to clamp the update value"},{"offset":5,"meaning":"base step for computing the next update value"},{"offset":6,"meaning":"pending update flag, cleared after handling"},{"offset":7,"meaning":"current update value"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"update interval multiplier used with 60000 ticks"},{"offset":11,"meaning":"associated timer state or armed flag"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"embedded kernel timer/event object"}]}
